long_biography.plain_text:
Hing Chao studied philosophy at Durham University before spending time in Beijing and among Orochen communities in northeast China. Those experiences led him to establish the Orochen Foundation and later the Hong Kong Culture Festival. He also founded the International Guoshu Association, developing publications, exhibitions and university partnerships that document martial traditions through digital archives and motion-capture technology.

Chao eventually returned to Wah Kwong Maritime Transport, the shipping company founded by his grandfather. After becoming chairman in 2019, he divided the business between shipowning and asset management, then added third-party ship management and dry-bulk operating activities. His wider maritime roles now include chairing the Hong Kong Chamber of Shipping and industry councils focused on decarbonisation. The commercial and cultural strands remain distinct parts of his career.
